Absolutely incredible dining experience! The food here is outstanding. The lamb was the star of the night—so incredibly delicious, tender, and juicy, it practically melted in my mouth. The salad was remarkably fresh and crisp, and pairing it all with their signature one-meter-long bread was an absolute game-changer. The combination was flawless! For drinks, we ordered the lemon mint juice, which was recommended by our waiter. It turned out to be the perfect pairing for the meal—so refreshing and beautifully balanced. Highly recommend this place and will definitely be back!
